prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 4 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%, +11.4%, +7.9%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful in 1 test (+7.0%), but 2 hurt performance (-3.7%, -3.8%) and 1 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) and step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test each (-7.5% and -3.8% respectively) and showed no clear effect in all other tests.
Copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured, +0.0% vs +7.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):

- adoption, new_screen: +2.5% over 5 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.2% over 1 test(s)

- choose_path, redesign: -3.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.2% over 2 test(s)
- finish, hint: +4.2% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +8.0% over 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.5% over 9 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +0.6% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: +1.6% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Pet Path Discovery Screen: Insert a interactive pet path preview screen right after the story screen to let users test path choices visually before committing. (why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion with a high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation when selecting a path.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Customization: Move sign-in to take place after pet selection and customization so users invest in their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently happens before pet creation, causing early friction (75.8% conversion).)
2: [home, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Readiness Verification Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop verification screen right before home intro to ensure the window overlay permissions are working. (why: App stalls and desktop visibility bugs account for multiple support tickets during the home transition.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Value Proposition Card Highlights: Reorganize the path selection page into a structured grid layout with highlighted feature badges on each option. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users immediately at the start of onboarding.)
4: [finish, hint] First Interaction Quick Reference Bar on Home Intro: Display a fixed hint bar on the completion screen listing key shortcuts for hiding and talking to the companion. (why: Users completing onboarding often experience confusion regarding companion management commands.)

scores.note: Targeting step with high hesitation time using high-performing new_screen format.
Reordering flows historically carries risk, though sign_in reorders had minor success.
Both support tickets and funnel data back this issue, and new screens perform well.
Layout changes for choose_path consistently showed negative historical results.
Hints on the finish step have shown positive historical lift of +4.2%.
